name: Ali Hooshangi
description: Ali Hooshangi is a skilled Frontend Developer and Web Designer with over 6 years of professional experience. He specializes in building high-performance, responsive, and visually appealing websites using Next.js, React.js, Tailwind CSS, and WordPress. Ali has a strong focus on website optimization, security, and user experience, ensuring projects are fast, accessible, and SEO-friendly. Passionate about technology and continuous learning, he combines technical expertise with creative design to deliver modern and effective digital solutions.
